text:
ana.sales: Helix POC (dedicated-us-west) demo team reporting TTFT jumps after we moved them to redwood/q4_kv. Median went from ~110ms -> ~850ms, seeing lots of kv_cache miss and small-batch logs. Demo in 2 hours, need triage.

ryan.eng: Can you share a sample request and which endpoint? Also deployment id.

ana.sales: Hitting /v1/generate, model=redwood/q4_kv-1, deployment=dedicated-usw-7. Sample: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/q4_kv-1","input":"Invoice summary for acct 55"}'`

mina.ml: Common causes: client is embedding ephemeral session ids in prompt (kills prefix cache) or batch_window too small -> many size=1 batches.

sam.runtime: I pulled the config: `batch_window_ms=6`, `max_batch_size=32`, `prefetch=false`. That explains size=1 batches and no warm KV.

ryan.eng: Ask customer to stop putting epoch timestamps in prompt; use header `x-session` instead.

ana.sales: I'll ping them. Can you try a quick runtime tweak?

sam.runtime: Will push `batch_window_ms=35` and `prefetch=true` for dedicated-usw-7 now. deploy-bot: rollout started by sam.runtime.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for dedicated-usw-7.

sam.runtime: Replayed 150 requests: median TTFT -> ~130ms, 95p -> ~240ms, cache-miss rate dropped from 38% to 9%.

linda.cs: Also sent SOC2 and network peering docs to the customer and offered extra POC credits.

ana.sales: Customer confirmed demo improved. Next steps: 1) customer to move session id to headers; 2) sales to propose reserved commit for sustained low-latency; 3) runtime to consider default `prefetch=true` for low-entropy workloads.

mina.ml: Filing ML ticket ML-3309 to add onboarding warning for high-entropy prompt tokens.

ana.sales: Thanks team! :raised_hands:
